stars.center: Not Quite Hollywood: The Wild, Untold Story of Ozploitation
edges: Quentin Tarantino dedicated his film Kill Bill to the exploitation genre.
Not Quite Hollywood premiered at the Melbourne International Film Festival.
Not Quite Hollywood was nominated for Best Documentary at the 2008 Australian Film Institute Awards.

Not Quite Hollywood had its overseas premiere at the Toronto Film Festival.
Margaret Pomeranz gave Not Quite Hollywood a positive review.
